description: Source code for reftable merged table implementation, including iterator management, merging logic, and table initialization functions.

classes.name: merged_subiter
classes.description: Structure representing a sub-iterator within the merged table, holding an iterator and a record.

classes.name: merged_iter
classes.description: Structure managing multiple sub-iterators, a priority queue, and iteration state for merged table traversal.

methods.name: merged_iter_close
methods.description: Closes and releases resources associated with a merged_iter instance.

methods.name: merged_iter_advance_subiter
methods.description: Advances a specific sub-iterator and updates the priority queue.

methods.name: merged_iter_seek
methods.description: Seeks all sub-iterators to a specific record.

methods.name: merged_iter_next_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the next merged record, handling multiple sub-iterators and ordering.

methods.name: merged_iter_seek_void
methods.description: Wrapper for merged_iter_seek to match function pointer signature.

methods.name: merged_iter_next_void
methods.description: Wrapper for merged_iter_next_entry to match function pointer signature, skipping deletions if configured.

methods.name: iterator_from_merged_iter
methods.description: Initializes a reftable_iterator with a merged_iter instance.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_new
methods.description: Creates a new merged table from an array of tables, verifying hash IDs and calculating min/max indices.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_max_update_index
methods.description: Returns the maximum update index of the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_min_update_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum update index of the merged table.

methods.name: merged_table_init_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over a merged table, setting up sub-iterators for each underlying table.
